notes.title: GD Create: Empowering Content Creators in Bombergrounds!🎥✨
notes.notes:
Hello Bombers! 💣

We're thrilled to introduce the [b]GD Create Program![/b] The all-new platform [b]designed for content creators like you![/b] Whether you're streaming on Twitch, creating YouTube videos or posting on X (formerly Twitter), GD Create offers an incredible opportunity to take your content to the next level and earn real rewards while you're at it. 🎉

 
[h2][b]What is GD Create?[/b][/h2]
GD Create is a dedicated platform where [b]creators can sign up[/b] to receive their [b]own unique creator code[/b]. When your followers use that code to make in-game purchases in Bombergrounds, [b]you’ll earn 10% of those purchases[/b]. This is your [b]chance to monetize your passion[/b] and continue to fuel the creativity that makes the Bombergrounds community so vibrant & explosive! 💪
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/40f0c18267a95cef809a3e8e5d750903e0c41dc1.png[/img]

🫂 [b]Be Part of the Community[/b]: Stay closely connected with Bombergrounds fans and players by bringing your unique content to the table.
🎁 [b]Support Your Followers[/b]: Share exclusive perks with your community in the form of giveaways and contests, creating even more exciting experiences for them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/70ee24540e20ca470bbc40ae5b1f79686e4ab6f9.png[/img]

It’s simple!
[list]

 	[*]Then visit the [b]GD Create website[/b] ([url=https://create.giganticduck.com/]https://create.giganticduck.com/[/url]), log-in with your Gigantic Duck ID and submit your application to get your own personalized creator code. Once approved, you’ll be ready to start earning from the purchases made using your code![/*]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/486de92089417b226be005803aef3b33346914ba.png[/img]

 
[h3][b]Take Your Creativity to the Next Level 🚀[/b][/h3]
Whether you’re a veteran content creator or just getting started in your journey, GD Create opens the door to exciting new opportunities. Showcase your passion for Bombergrounds, grow your fanbase, and turn your creative efforts into tangible rewards!

[b]Get Started Now![/b]
Ready to dive in? [b]Sign up today on the [url=https://create.giganticduck.com]GD Create website![/url][/b] earn rewards and become a recognized creator in the Bombergrounds community. We can’t wait to see what you create, Bombers!

notes.title: Bombergrounds: Classic – Release Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hello, Bombers! 💣

We're excited to announce the upcoming release of [b]Bombergrounds: Classic[/b], launching on [b]September 27, 2024[/b]! 🎉 Whether you play solo or with friends, Classic brings back the fun of old-school arena combat while pushing the intensity and strategy to new heights. Be ready for fast-paced, action-packed fun that demands both brains and reflexes!

[h2]Why You’ll Love Bombergrounds: Classic:[/h2]
💥 [b]Faster Gameplay[/b] - Intensity turned up to the max. The matches are quicker and the movement is faster, making every second a high-stakes decision.

💥 [b]No Pay-to-Win[/b] - Everyone competes on an equal footing. Your success depends purely on skill—no gameplay advantages here!

💥 [b]One-Hit Kills[/b] - Every move matters! Outmaneuver and outsmart your enemies in lightning-fast battles where a single hit seals your fate.

💥 [b]New Leaderboards[/b] - Prove your worth by climbing the global leaderboards. Will you be the next top bomber? 🎖️

💥 [b]New Progression System: Levels[/b] - Unlock exciting rewards as you progress through the game's leveling system. The higher you go, the more you can show off your skills and dedication!

💥 [b]New Cosmetic-Only Boxes[/b] - Want to stand out from the crowd? Now you can, with cosmetic items that won’t affect gameplay. These boxes can be earned with either gems or coins - meaning you can unlock them just by playing!


[h2]Early Access Offer![/h2]
[b]Bombergrounds: Classic[/b] will be available in Early Access for just [b]$9.99 USD[/b]. Take advantage of this limited-time discount before the full release price of $14.99 USD. Don’t miss your chance to be one of the first to experience the action and start climbing the leaderboards!

notes.title: Bombergrounds Spacelands Patch 1.6.1
notes.notes:
Dive into the latest Bombergrounds update with patch 1.6.1! 🚀 The Gigantic Duck Team is back with another exciting patch that includes critical bug fixes, fresh features, and reworks to enhance your Bombergrounds experience. Let's break down what's new and improved in this update!


[h3]🔄 REMAKE - Giro Ability Rework[/h3]
Giro, the beloved giraffe 🦒 known for the unique ability to interact with the environment, has received a [b]significant rework[/b]. Giro can now use its ability and [b]consume grass anywhere on the map[/b], regardless of whether there are grass patches. This change opens up new strategic possibilities and ensures Giro remains a versatile and fun character to play in all scenarios.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/176454736dff75fe95642c3ea89b05a52ee081cd.gif[/img]


[h3]🌟 NEW - League Points and Updated League Progress System[/h3]

In our recent 1.6.0 patch, we introduced the new League Progress and mentioned that it will now be distinct from your total trophies. However, the icons for total trophies and League Progress remained the same, which could create some confusion among players. To better showcase the changes to League Progress, we are introducing League Points with a new icon.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/faa9747aa3043bf85650c9ebb39e5f1eaf3ba37a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/8a68cdb7a9752807d173c1397e9d4caa59710695.png[/img][/url]

In addition to introducing League Points, we've now updated the League Progress system with [b]new ranks and icons[/b] to better showcase your achievements and progress. The journey through the leagues has never been more clear or rewarding:
[list]
[*] [b]Bronze[/b] starts at 10 league points
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/f1ac99a7d07be47a6037c145388a332666315d50.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/14c1aed58dac2b84427890ab14cf7dd4dfac957e.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/7eaedfa7eeaa9982fa2f69a7b215bdcf7386f2c0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/bf26922b70bf0cecb00a140f0a5aac05b24dfe6b.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/74c537d2cc4b618651c02da2a1e00aad75714071.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/a652d6667593245ccf8854bd8b8a8682ac0222e6.png[/img][/url]
[*] [b]Platinum[/b] starts at 8400 league points
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/a07c297c6307015a94cb83d2a5b81eb95456b8e7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/c078e75c4aaf92bc2d958a7204cfbd079e241568.png[/img][/url]
[*] [b]Diamond[/b] starts at 12400 league points
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/1ce96f58caa13c5c0b5d228c374206f136970114.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/3b972f0292fe0dc6f9165ada2ead097fb4b93228.png[/img][/url]
[*] [b]Master[/b] starts at 20000 league points
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/51c65b6a4660bb4f254a926d16224867059f0b61.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/82a04191e96580254c337fc8379bccab93095e07.png[/img][/url]
[*] [b]Grandmaster[/b] starts at 25000 league points
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/286b155341f2f6db56e6969bb9c39391dd5113ee.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/6e25ff262144fd43f37e065e21f1292a99f791e2.png[/img][/url]
[*] [b]Legend[/b] is the pinnacle, starting at 30000 league points
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/4a50019c48b22144c494d45c75ef3ec9d9f497d8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/56cb7555ab6e57870a9649bd3386184c71efd21e.png[/img][/url]
[/list]

These new ranks and icons are designed to give you a more visual and rewarding progression experience through the game.


[h3]🛠️ BUG FIXES - In-Game[/h3]
We've squashed several bugs to provide a smoother gameplay experience:
[list]
[*] Fixed an in-game crash related to Brie’s trap and other damage sources.
[*] Resolved issues with Giro’s ability: Giro will no longer get stuck or become non-functional if bombed while using its ability.
[*] Eliminated occasional stutters in-game, ensuring a more fluid and enjoyable gaming session.
[*] Fixed Hoppy and Volter’s instant ground teleport: Corrected to prevent unintended ability recast effects.
[*] Fixed unable to use bat after respawn: dying while holding the bat charge won’t prevent bat use after you respawn.
[*] Fixed Quaker’s hitbox mismatch: Adjusted to accurately cover the intended circle area.
[*] and more..
[/list]


[h3]🛠️ BUG FIXES - Lobby[/h3]
Fixed the tutorial pointer: Some players encountered issues with the tutorial pointer being bugged. This has now been addressed, making the tutorial experience smoother for new players.


Join the community and share your thoughts on this update by joining our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/bombergrounds]https://discord.gg/bombergrounds[/url].

Your feedback is invaluable to us as we continue to make Bombergrounds the best it can be. Whether you're strategizing with Giro or climbing the ranks with League Points, we hope you enjoy the new changes! 🎮


[i]Stay explosive,[/i]
[i]The Gigantic Duck Team[/i]

[h3]🐼 NEW - HYPER CHARACTER: Lullaby, the Dreamy Panda[/h3]
Meet Lullaby, the Dreamy Panda, our latest Hyper Character. With Lullaby joining the fray, expect your battles to be filled with dreamy pandemonium and strategic depth. Don't sleep on adding this cuddly yet formidable fighter to your roster!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/2760012569032e3e7374ac08b9b3507eb9a373a8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/7a37dc22fdb02acb14811189817d1ad903d98bd5.png[/img][/url]

[h3]🏆 REMAKE - League Progress[/h3]
We've completely remade the League Progress system! Now, you can unlock up to 15 characters as you climb up the ranks. Each victory brings you closer to new allies on the battlefield.

[b]Important:[/b] Given that the League Progress is a now brand-new system with different rewards, distinct from the player's overall trophy count, we are resetting the League Progress trophies for all players to zero. This reset allows players the opportunity to earn rewards right from the beginning of the League Progress journey.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35369689/b7db71d754b97a1e6949a9c22777166ec0702ce6.png[/img]

[h3]💳 REMAKE - Bomber Pass: Now Only $4.99[/h3]
We are excited to announce [u]a lower Bomber Pass cost[/u], now just [b]USD 4.99[/b], down from USD 12.99! While also switching the purchase option to real money. This change allows us to pack the Bomber Pass with all those random rewards you love, making each day’s grind full of potential treasures.


[h3]📚 NEW - Tutorial Game Modes & Tutorial Pointers for New Players[/h3]
Welcome, new Bombers! To get you started on the right foot, we've introduced new tutorial game modes and a tutorial pointer system. The pointer system will help guide new players to things like league progress, upgrading animals, claiming free shop items, etc.. The option to disable pointers is available in the game settings.


[h3]✨ NEW - Earn Star Upgrades in the League Progress![/h3]
Climb the league and earn star quality upgrades to enhance your characters. The higher you go, the stronger you become!


[h3]🛠️ Minor Changes and Fixes[/h3]
Shop Updates: We're introducing Guaranteed Drops info for Box Opens, making your shopping experience more transparent and rewarding.
Bug Fixes: Many in-game and lobby bugs have been resolved, ensuring a smoother and more stable gaming experience.


[h3]⚖️ REMAKE - Balancing Overhaul[/h3]
We've conducted a comprehensive balancing overhaul. All animals have been re-balanced, re-tuned, and optimized to ensure a fun and exciting gameplay experience for everyone. Expect a new level of competitiveness and strategy on the battlefield!

notes.title: Welcome to Season 5, the Cyber Arcade!

Embark on the ultimate gaming journey with our Cyber Arcade Season update! Unleash the power of new "Hypers" class heroes Clawz, Polaris, & Volter, and strive for excellence with our new Star System, rewarding you with up to 5-Star animal unlocks.

Join the fray in fresh, dynamic events from the mayhem of Absolute Chaos to the strategic depths of Maze Royale. Engage in high-stakes contests like Dangerous Water and Powerup Frenzy to outsmart and outlast your opponents.

Your mastery and dedication now pay off more than ever with enhanced Rune Packs and a treasure trove of rewards. Plus, the introduction of Blast Bucks lets you gear up with new BB Originals, enriching your arsenal and strategy.

Dress to impress with new Cyber Arcade Skins and golden gear while experiencing refined gameplay through our overhauled Bot AI and skill balance. Revel in a revamped daily rewards system and a more intuitive game mode selector, all optimized for smoother performance on every device.

With the Bomber Pass now expanded to 120 tiers and an enriched loot system, the thrill of the game has never been greater. And, with UI enhancements like expanded emoji slots, your in-game expression is as vivid as the battles you'll wage.

Join us in the Cyber Arcade – where every match is an opportunity to shine!

We are extremely excited to announce Patch 1.4.0, named "Season 4: Dino Park"! This hefty update not only delivers a blast from the past with prehistoric fun but also brings a slew of performance upgrades and bug fixes aimed at making your gameplay experience smoother than ever before.

New Season! Dino Park: Welcome to Dino Park! Enjoy the prehistoric ambience with a new animal, map theme, emojis, and skins!
New Animal! Slowy the Sloth: The latest member of our animal gang. He might be slow, but don't underestimate his impact!

Banana Guy

T-Rex

[b]League Progress[/b]
[i]Blast Bucks as a League Progress Reward[/i]
Starting from this patch, our League Progress system will incorporate Blast Bucks. Every time you rank up into a new league, say from Silver I to Silver II, you'll earn a sweet reward of 100 Blast Bucks. You can now spend these bad boys in the in-game Blast Bucks shop for more than just Cosmetic rewards. Imagine that!

But that's not all! To commemorate your hard work, there's a hefty prize of 1,000 Blast Bucks waiting for you at the end of the league progress. Save up, splurge, and make your bombergrounds experience even more explosive!

[i]The Golden Bomb[/i]
And now, for the crown jewel of the League Progress rewards... The Legendary Golden Bomb! A shining beacon of your bomber prowess, this bomb is unlike anything any player has ever seen before. It gleams with such glory that no one will mistake how cool it is. To add this radiant bomb to your arsenal, you'll need to collect 50,000 trophies. But believe us when we say, it's worth every single trophy!

[i]Seasonal League Resets[/i]
With the arrival of every new season in Bombergrounds: Reborn, we'll be resetting the league progress rewards. This is your chance to begin anew, setting your sights on exciting rewards and the exhilarating climb up the ranks. So, each season will offer fresh challenges and fresh rewards. Are you ready to rise to the occasion?

Let these updates ignite your competitive spirit and fuel your journey through the thrilling landscape of Bombergrounds: Reborn. We can't wait to see how you utilize these new updates to create some epic bomber moments.

[i]We're jazzing up our Box system in Patch 1.4.0 to make it even more rewarding:[/i]
Boxes are Bursting with More: Small Box now gives 2 rewards (up from 1), Big Box gives 4 (previously 2), and Mega Box now gives out 6 total rewards, which means more bang for your buck!
Higher Box, Higher Value: If you can afford it, a Mega Box will outshine a Small Box and Big Box every time!
What's in the Box? Check out the potential goodies and their drop rates by clicking on Boxes in the shop.
Changes to Rewards System: We're moving cosmetic parts out of the Bomber Pass and League Progress rewards. Instead, enjoy a higher chance to snag emojis and cosmetics in your Boxes!

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[i]Performance[/i]
Startup Stability: We've addressed and fixed the startup crashes on many devices. We're still observing this problem for future patches.
Loading Speed: Initial game start-up loading time and in-game match loading times have been significantly improved.
UI Enhancements: Experience a more responsive and efficient user interface. Especially in Bomber Pass, League Progress, and the Main Lobby.
Memory Management: Improved memory usage for a smoother gaming experience.
Overall Performance Boost: General improvements to performance have been implemented for your bombing pleasure!

[i]Bug Fixes[/i]
Iggy's Boundaries: Iggy no longer pulls itself to walls.
Konnie's Indication: The ability indicator for Konnie is now correctly sized.
Team Mode Tweaks: Fixed the issue of player UI appearing on the intro screen in team game modes.
The Bush Dilemma: Resolved the gigantic bush issue. 😅
Hats on your knees: Resolved a bug where hats could be put on the knees of players in-game.
Minor Fixes: Various other small bugfixes have been applied for an optimized experience.

There you have it, Bombergrounds enjoyers! We hope these changes will heighten your fun, sharpen your strategy, and reward your passion for Bombergrounds: Reborn. We appreciate your support and look forward to hearing your feedback on Season 4: Dino Park.

So, buckle up, and let's embark on this thrilling prehistoric journey!

Happy Bombing!

-The Bombergrounds Team

Hello everyone 🥰

The development team have implemented several changes to improve game balance. While we understand that players may have differing opinions about these changes, we believe that they are necessary for the long-term success and sustainability of the game. We value the feedback of our community and will continue to monitor the impact of these changes.

[h2]Gameplay Balance Changes[/h2]

[b]Game Mode: Battle Royale changes[/b]
In order to enhance the frenetic and unpredictable nature of Battle Royale matches, we have made the following changes to address issues of slow or comfortable gameplay.

We have reduced the time it takes for cubes to start falling from the sides of the map to just 4 seconds after the start of the game, down from 60 seconds previously. Similarly, the sudden death feature now activates 25 seconds after the map has shrunk, rather than 40 seconds beforehand. We believe that these adjustments will bring back the excitement and thrill of this game mode, as it was intended to be.

[b]Powerup Drop Rates[/b]
Powerups now drop at an equal chance of 20%, when a crate drops loot. Each crate has an 80% chance of dropping loot.

Powerup: Damage (20% chance of dropping)
Powerup: Speed (20% chance of dropping)
Powerup: Health (20% chance of dropping)

Once a powerup drops, there is a 20% chance of it becoming a Golden Powerup, which raises the quality of the powerup by a substantial margin.

[b]Star Drop Rates[/b]
We have made adjustments to the star system in order to address imbalances that were causing players to consistently reach Star Power 3 too quickly. With these changes, we hope to make the process of achieving Star Power 3 more enjoyable and rewarding.

Crates will now drop a minimum of 2 stars and a maximum of 3 stars, as long as they contain loot.
Event Discovery

We have adjusted the “new event” bomb reward up to 2 Bombs, up from previous 1 Bomb per Event Discovery.

notes.title: 0.8.6 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Rejoice! The first big patch is here – version 0.8.6.

This patch mostly fixes bugs and problems with the game that you have reported during the past two weeks of play. We take these bugs seriously and we want to fix them before adding more content. We will address new content in the next patch.

Firstly, we want to thank everyone that has reported bugs in our Discord channel. Secondly, we’ve had a few setbacks that have delayed this patch that have been outside of our control, so we want to thank you deeply for supporting us and our development. 🙂



Patch delivery & details
Details
Previous live version: 0.8.3 (all platforms)
Updates to: 0.8.6 (all platforms)

Delivery date/time
We are going to patch immediately.

Downtime expected
30 minutes to 1 hour.

Patch notes
Region changes

Added region – SEA (Singapore)
Added region – South America (Sao Paolo)
Queue – The region you are queueing towards is now shown in the queueing status text.
Balance changes

Balance – Minimum amount of stars that can drop from a dead player is raised to 3.
Balance – Maximum distance to pick up an item has been lowered and stabilized a bit.
Game Server changes

Bugfix – Bombs falling into water no longer disappears on the client but explodes on the server (invisible bombs bug)
Bugfix – Bombs falling into wall objects no longer happens (invisible bombs bug)
Bugfix – Double items from crates is now resolved. It should now give the appropriate amount of items
Bugfix – Coins not being received after lv 50
Bugfix – Being able to easily clip through wall blocks that are placed in a certain manner
Stability – Fixed disconnect loop when reconnecting bug
Stability – Added dynamic region support
Client changes

Performance – Lowered texture resolution a bit more
Performance – Lowered resolution for low/mid settings, your game should look worse in these settings but perform better FPS wise.
Performance – Recent friends list is now overwritten every time a new game ends, so it does not store all players in a huge list.
Performance – Added a FPS/Latency setting to be able to diagnose ping/fps while playing.
Stability – The “game starting…” bug but a game never stars, should be fixed.
Controls – Added a “fixed joystick” setting for mobile
Controls – Added keybind options for PC/Mac
Login – Auto-log in with Gigantic Duck ID: It is now possible to log in automatically after using a Gigantic Duck ID. It will be saved for as long as you don’t log into another account (like a guest account or another Gigantic Duck ID).
Login – You can now click “log in with Gigantic Duck ID” instead of having to create a new username.
UI – Some Lobby UI parts were showing while in-game.
UI – Opening chests should now update the status of the item you got accordingly (the checkmark).
UI – Fixed profile stats not scaling properly
UI – Fixed profile “time played” not showing the correct time
UI – Fixed profile screen player name scaling bug
UI – Fixed “logging in” status when picking a wrong or unavailable username on registration (visual bug)
UI – Extended hit area for Exit & Settings buttons
UI – Added discord and twitter buttons
UI – Fixed gameoverscreen stats bug (“11:11, 11, level 50”)
UI – Fixed “link account” button not animating sometimes
UI – Added text feedback about current queue region
UI – Fixed steam shop page displaying wrong currency in some countries
UI – Updated region settings dropdown
UI – Updated resolution settings to use users screen (Desktop)
Graphics – Fixed Picnic Bear helmet texture
Content Creator changes

Added streamer settings:
1. Hide chat
2. Hide names
3. Block friend requests
